classes.doc:
** This class is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

Provides access to a material assignment in the study.

functions.doc: Reverts this material to the original design model material, removing any study-specific override
functions.name: revertToModelMaterial

functions.doc: Assigns a new material to the body associated with this MaterialAssignment, overriding any current material assignment
functions.name: assignMaterial

classes.name: MaterialAssignment

properties.doc: Indicates whether the original design material was used or the material is overridden by the study
properties.name: isModelMaterial

properties.doc: Gets or sets the safety factor type used for this material in safety factor calculations
properties.name: safetyFactorType

properties.doc: Gets the core Material object for this assignment (override if present, otherwise the model material)
properties.name: material

properties.doc: Gets whether the assigned material is valid for this study type
properties.name: isMaterialValid

properties.doc: Gets the design body that this material is assigned to
properties.name: body

classes.doc:
** This class is a preview feature and may change in future releases. Do not use it in distributed programs. **

Provides access to the material assignments for all bodies in the study.

functions.doc: Returns the material assignment at the given index
functions.name: item

classes.name: MaterialAssignments

properties.doc: Returns the number of material assignments (one per body)
properties.name: count
